title: The End of Foundation Era Crypto

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Protocols must become unincorporated associations to avoid legal entanglements and ensure true decentralization. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: A statutory association allows clear governance, dispute resolution, and compliance without sacrificing decentralization. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ethereum's transition to PoS shows that unincorporated models scale better, with no central point of failure. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Statutory associations, like DAOs with legal entity status, provide enforceable rights and access to traditional finance. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Legal clarity and institutional trust are non-negotiable for mass adoption. (4 sec)

caption_text:
protocols must transition to a unincorporated association vs a decentralized statutory association.
